environment.execution: rootful Docker with pinned distinct physical CPUs
environment.workload: bursty_io exact openat oracle; deterministic CPU gap after each 32 operations

supported_result.interpretation: A fixed 50 us idle backoff regresses the bursty unique-edge workload.

decision: Retain CONTINUOUS as the production default. No bounded policy has a paired workload interval that supports an improvement, while fixed 50 us has a supported unique-edge regression. Lower CPU or receipt-age medians without paired support do not justify changing exact-attribution delivery behavior.
